kultivator.goals.reward.11: 8 Immortal Origin Stones and a spare Realm Crossing Talisman
kultivator.goals.reward.12: A Shan Hai Scroll of the kind you choose
kultivator.goals.reward.13: 20 Immortal Essence Pearls and 2 Heaven Seal Shards
kultivator.goals.step.a_realm.how: At Dewa Abadi Peak with 9 stars, pass the final ascension (Immortality scroll, Alam tablet).
kultivator.goals.step.a_stone.how: Mine stone by hand on the floating islands of the Immortal Realm.
kultivator.goals.step.a_essence.how: Meditate and fight in the Immortal Realm until your Immortal Essence reaches 50.
kultivator.goals.step.a_cross.how: Use the Realm Crossing Talisman to return home from the Immortal Realm.
kultivator.goals.step.a_primordial.how: Kun-Peng, Zhulong or Taotie appear rarely in the Immortal Realm, or are called with a Shan Hai Scroll.
kultivator.goals.step.a_kunpeng.how: Defeat Kun-Peng through all three of its phases.
kultivator.goals.step.a_auction.how: In the Immortal Realm, outbid the rival elders on the Lelang tablet with Origin Stones.
kultivator.goals.step.a_pursuit.how: An offended rival may send a band after a contested win. Defeat it.
kultivator.goals.step.a_calamity.how: When a star is gated, start the waiting calamity on the Bencana tablet and survive it.
kultivator.goals.step.a_wrath.how: When the Heavens send envoys to your home, clear every wave.
kultivator.goals.step.a_general.how: Defeat the Heaven General who comes after the envoys.
kultivator.goals.step.a_nine.how: Expand your inner world to 9 plots (Batin tablet: Expand, or a Land Expansion Token).
kultivator.goals.step.a_millennium.how: Grow a herb to 1,000 years in your inner world and harvest it.
kultivator.goals.step.a_batin_cal.how: Survive an earthly calamity of your inner world, live or while away.
kultivator.goals.step.a_rockmen.how: Feed 64 ores into the pit on the Batin tablet.
kultivator.goals.step.a_own.how: Create a technique on the Ciptaan tablet: two Daos, a form and a name.
kultivator.goals.step.a_perfect.how: Bring a created art to 100%% Perfection (Perfect re-rolls it).
kultivator.goals.step.a_three.how: Defeat all three primordial beasts: Kun-Peng, Zhulong and Taotie.
kultivator.jalan9.page.book.tip: Turn between First Steps (chapters 1-5), the World Path (6-10) and the Immortal Path (11-15).
kultivator.jalan9.page.realm: Meant for: Dewa Abadi Peak and beyond
kultivator.jalan9.page.title: Title: Immortal Ancestor
advancement.kultivator.immortal_path_com: Finish all twenty steps of the Immortal Path (chapters 11-15)
kultivator.screen.help.jalan_abadi.title: The Immortal Path
kultivator.screen.help.jalan_abadi: After chapter 10 the Path tablet turns to the Immortal Path (the coin under the chapter tablets, third book): chapters 11-15, twenty steps for a Dewa Abadi Peak, each ticked by its achievement: the Immortal Realm and its Origin Stones, the primordial beasts and the auction, the star calamities and the Heavens' wrath, your inner world, and finally your own created arts. Each chapter has one reward (Origin Stones and a talisman, a Shan Hai Scroll, pearls and seal shards, a Land Expansion Token, the title "Immortal Ancestor"). New daily chores join once you ascended: slay Immortal Realm natives, mine an Origin Stone, harvest an inner-world plot, bid at an auction. Source: the ladder and every number are game design; each feature names its own source.
